description: External Linked Web Storage deployments per authentication suite (live, configured by environment). No public LWS deployment is known; mock fixtures are not listed here.

targets.name: LWS deployment, OpenID Connect suite (ID token from a browser login, RFC 8693 exchange)
notes: no public LWS deployment is known (2026-09-27); configure a deployment you are allowed to test. The repository's LWS fixtures in test/helpers/lws.js are mocks and are not interoperability evidence
LWS 1.0 Operations define no HTTP binding yet at 268fd25: writes use PUT with If-None-Match: * / If-Match
unattended (session mode): unverified — depends on the OpenID provider's consent and MFA policy; fails closed if interaction is needed

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_STORAGE
env.description: storage (or the part the test identity may use, ends with /) of the openid deployment; for lws.boundary-automatic it must be the StorageRoot endpoint advertised by the storage description

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_SCRATCH
env.description: container dedicated to test writes inside the storage (ends with /); omit for read-only runs

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_PRIVATE_RESOURCE
env.description: an existing private resource the test identity may read (read-only runs)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_OTHER_PROTECTED
env.description: a protected resource outside the storage (read-only boundary probe)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_AUTHORIZATION_SERVER
env.description: the storage's authorization server (as_uri) when it is not on the storage's origin; trusted explicitly

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_SUBJECT
env.description: the agent identifier the storage should see (ID token sub URI); required so strict results are tied to the test identity

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_ISSUER
env.description: the OpenID provider trusted by the deployment (issues URI sub and azp)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_CLIENT_ID
env.description: registered client ID at that provider (omit to use dynamic registration)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: client secret of a confidential registered client

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: loopback redirect URI registered for that client (default http://127.0.0.1:39398/callback)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_OPENID_STORAGE_STATE
env.description: Playwright storageState file of a dedicated test account's signed-in identity-provider session (contains cookies; never commit). With --headed it seeds the browser; without --headed it enables the fail-closed non-interactive session mode (a configured file that does not exist is a configuration error)

capabilityNotes.storageDiscovery: lws.boundary-automatic needs the first 401 to carry Link rel="https://www.w3.org/ns/lws#storage" to a same-origin storage description whose StorageRoot equals the configured storage and whose root HEAD links back; no LWS deployment has been observed yet (run with --exercise-unverified to observe it)

targets.name: LWS deployment, SAML 2.0 suite (assertion from the deployment's SAML service provider after a browser login)
notes: no public LWS deployment is known (2026-09-27); configure a deployment you are allowed to test. The repository's LWS fixtures in test/helpers/lws.js are mocks and are not interoperability evidence
LWS 1.0 Operations define no HTTP binding yet at 268fd25: writes use PUT with If-None-Match: * / If-Match
unattended (session mode): works only if the stored SP session still yields an assertion from the assertion endpoint; otherwise the adapter fails closed without opening a sign-in page

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_STORAGE
env.description: storage (or the part the test identity may use, ends with /) of the saml deployment; for lws.boundary-automatic it must be the StorageRoot endpoint advertised by the storage description

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_SCRATCH
env.description: container dedicated to test writes inside the storage (ends with /); omit for read-only runs

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_PRIVATE_RESOURCE
env.description: an existing private resource the test identity may read (read-only runs)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_OTHER_PROTECTED
env.description: a protected resource outside the storage (read-only boundary probe)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_AUTHORIZATION_SERVER
env.description: the storage's authorization server (as_uri) when it is not on the storage's origin; trusted explicitly

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_SUBJECT
env.description: leave unset: the SAML NameID stays inside the assertion, which the client does not parse, so the subject cannot be compared (setting it makes lws.login-read FAIL)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_LOGIN_URL
env.description: https URL that starts the SAML sign-in at the service provider

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_ASSERTION_ENDPOINT
env.description: https endpoint of the service provider returning {xml, recipient, notOnOrAfter} for ?audience=<as_uri> to the signed-in browser session

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_SAML_STORAGE_STATE
env.description: Playwright storageState file of a dedicated test account's signed-in identity-provider session (contains cookies; never commit). With --headed it seeds the browser; without --headed it enables the fail-closed non-interactive session mode (a configured file that does not exist is a configuration error); here the SAML service provider's session

capabilityNotes.storageDiscovery: lws.boundary-automatic needs the first 401 to carry Link rel="https://www.w3.org/ns/lws#storage" to a same-origin storage description whose StorageRoot equals the configured storage and whose root HEAD links back; no LWS deployment has been observed yet (run with --exercise-unverified to observe it)

targets.name: LWS deployment, self-signed identity with a controlled identifier document
notes: no public LWS deployment is known (2026-09-27); configure a deployment you are allowed to test. The repository's LWS fixtures in test/helpers/lws.js are mocks and are not interoperability evidence
LWS 1.0 Operations define no HTTP binding yet at 268fd25: writes use PUT with If-None-Match: * / If-Match
unattended: no browser; needs only the key file (materialized from a secret)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_STORAGE
env.description: storage (or the part the test identity may use, ends with /) of the controlled-identifier deployment; for lws.boundary-automatic it must be the StorageRoot endpoint advertised by the storage description

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_SCRATCH
env.description: container dedicated to test writes inside the storage (ends with /); omit for read-only runs

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_PRIVATE_RESOURCE
env.description: an existing private resource the test identity may read (read-only runs)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_OTHER_PROTECTED
env.description: a protected resource outside the storage (read-only boundary probe)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_AUTHORIZATION_SERVER
env.description: the storage's authorization server (as_uri) when it is not on the storage's origin; trusted explicitly

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_SUBJECT
env.description: optional: the controlled identifier is already fixed by RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_ID

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_ID
env.description: https URL of the agent's controlled identifier document (sub = iss = client_id)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_KEY_ID
env.description: verification method URL listed under authentication in that document (kid)

env.name: RA_INTEROP_LWS_CID_KEY_FILE
env.description: path to the private Ed25519 or P-256 JWK whose public key the document publishes (never commit)
